title: VF-EVAL: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs for Generating Feedback on AIGC Videos
benchmark_measurement: The paper's benchmark, VF-EVAL, evaluates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on AI-generated videos. One of the dimensions for error detection is 'Morality', which includes checks for 'sexual, violent, political' content. However, it does not explicitly measure any aspects of religion or faith.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
